population.population_statement: 10 development games, leave-one-whole-game-out predictions within that sample; 200 rollout starts (172 group-scored at +45); 2,164 +45 within-team pairs (1,064 Home / 1,100 Away, matching the frozen raw-frame counts); 142 EqualTeam-eligible +45 start/team cells; horizons are ordinal Image Id increments, not seconds; no independent tracking population exists on disk.
population.timebase: ordinal Image Id increments, not seconds

verdict: After the preregistered out-of-game additive correction, P1 negative-error persistence remains above its within-start permutation null for at least one candidate with a positive whole-game 95% gap interval. This is descriptive evidence in ten development games only; it does not establish pair-intent causality or justify building labels for adoption.
